description:
Eun Ji-woo, the adopted daughter of Taeyoung Group, is determined to restore everything to her adoptive mother, Jeon Hye-ju, who lost it all because of her. To achieve this, she targets the cousin of her treacherous ex-boyfriend: Kang In-hyuk, the CEO of Aether Hotel, who is notorious for his psychopathic tendencies. Abandoning her initial plans after being betrayed, she approaches In-hyuk directly, and he finds himself strangely intrigued by this woman who dares to walk into his life. *Original Web Novel by Ara-hwi*
